name: 91766 · Pomona, CA
findings: ZIP 91766 (Pomona) has 162 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (66% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91766 (Pomona) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
